_note: A BINARY build, deliberately: it needs no git server the cluster can reach, so the lab works on an air-gapped platform and on a training cluster alike, while the objects and commands are identical to a git-source build. Builds are NOT in the Educates session role (measured: create buildconfigs/builds/imagestreams all 'no'), so session.objects grants them — including builds/docker, which OpenShift gates separately from creating a BuildConfig because a Dockerfile build is more powerful than a source build. Output goes to the cluster's internal registry here; on DCS it goes to the tenant's Harbor project, which the last page covers.

steps.run: cd app && envsubst < Containerfile > C.tmp && mv C.tmp Containerfile && oc new-build --binary --strategy=docker --name=hello-built
envsubst < deployment.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc rollout status deploy/hello-built --timeout=240s
oc exec deploy/hello-built -- printenv GREETING VERSION
cd app && sed -i 's/Built on DCS, by me/Rebuilt, and it shows/' Containerfile && grep GREETING Containerfile
oc rollout restart deploy/hello-built && oc rollout status deploy/hello-built --timeout=240s
